WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (root-caused 2026-07-16): SDK agents load
setting_sources=['user'] and the user scope had no permissions block, so
every shell call went to the auto-mode classifier, which FAILS CLOSED when
its own LLM call errors or its transcript-bearing prompt overflows -- the
intermittent bare denial ('The user doesn't want to take this action right
now. STOP...') that killed builds. 106 denials / 59 sessions measured: 60
serena-shell, 39 Bash, 5 Read, 2 Write; zero in any session's first two
calls, median at call 14 (deeper agent -> larger classifier prompt).
Allowlisted tools take the classifier's fast-path and never reach it.
DELIBERATELY ABSENT: hooks (the SDK injects them programmatically so the
serena-crash fallback can drop them -- loading project settings.json would
break that) and MCP server keys (enabledMcpjsonServers /
enableAllProjectMcpServers would let every agent spawn its own stdio
serena from .mcp.json alongside the SDK's shared SSE one).
Rules are PORTABLE (no absolute paths) so this file can stay tracked.
